items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: And of course you know the stories, back in the 40s Buddy Childers and Art Pepper were both 16 when they joined the band

ctx.x: Yes. That’s my point. And I wonder if you knew back then that a lot of these musicians really wanted to be you or to be the tenor player or to — in other words they wanted to do what you were doing.

Definitely. Definitely. And there were times when we needed somebody where we got them from a college, or most of the time was from the summer camps. You know there were guys like Dennis Noday that were hired from the summer camps. You know and Stan — age didn’t matter to Stan it was how good you could play. When Gary Pack joined the band as a jazz trumpet player he was 19. And of course you know the stories, back in the 40s Buddy Childers and Art Pepper were both 16 when they joined the band and Stan had to sign…

Did Stan explain his vision to — there was a number of wonderful writers that did charts for the group and I’m wondering how much Stan would give them instructions. Here’s what I want, here’s what I don’t want, etcetera.
